name: Thunderstorm
primary:
A huge thundercloud gathers over the aimed spot, 12 blocks across.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky: at least 10 blocks of air above the target, so it fails in caves and under roofs.
It rains under the cloud and everyone inside gets wet. Lightning strikes every 0.3–0.7 s, mostly into monsters:
• Damage 6 ❤ lightning within 2.5 blocks (×2 on wet)
• Charge 60
• Sometimes sets the ground on fire and shatters weak blocks: glass, leaves, dirt, sand
self_description:
On you:
• Charge 40: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Speed IV for 15 s
